cc @belucid 👋

## What this is (the human version)

Google just shipped **[Antigravity CLI](https://developers.googleblog.com/an-important-update-transitioning-gemini-cli-to-antigravity-cli/)** — the terminal coding agent that replaces Gemini CLI, invoked as the `agy` binary ([docs](https://antigravity.google/docs/cli-using)). This PR teaches the SpecStory CLI to capture those sessions, so anything you do with `agy` shows up as clean markdown history (and syncs to SpecStory Cloud) exactly like Claude Code, Cursor CLI, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Droid CLI, and DeepSeek TUI already do.

In other words: **`specstory sync antigravity` now works.** Run Antigravity in your project, then sync, and you get a readable transcript of your prompts, the model's reasoning, every tool call, and the results.

## How it works

Antigravity stores each conversation as an append-only JSONL transcript buried at:

```
~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl
```

The new `antigravity` provider parses those step-by-step transcripts, groups them into conversation turns, stitches each tool result back onto the tool call that produced it, and renders Antigravity's tools (`run_command`, `view_file`, `write_to_file`, `replace_file_content`, `grep_search`, `list_dir`, …) into the unified SpecStory markdown format.

## The interesting/tricky bits

A few things made Antigravity different from every provider we've added so far — worth a look in review:

- **Binary is `agy`** (not `antigravity`); version via `agy --version`, resume via `--conversation <id>`.
- **Tool results are separate transcript steps with no call→result id**, so results are matched to their originating tool call positionally (FIFO). Async/long-running command output (which lands in a separate `tasks/task-N.log`) is folded back in too.
- **Transcripts carry no workspace field**, and `history.jsonl` only logs *interactive* sessions (not `agy -p` print mode). So the workspace is taken from history when available. Text-only sessions with no recoverable workspace are returned only on explicit `-s <id>` requests, never in project-filtered bulk listings (so they can't pollute unrelated projects).
- **The watcher** establishes fsnotify watches level-by-level as that deeply-nested transcript directory gets created, since fsnotify isn't recursive.

The full reverse-engineered on-disk format is documented in [`docs/antigravity-format-spec.md`](specstory-cli/docs/antigravity-format-spec.md) for future maintainers.

## What's included

- New `pkg/providers/antigravitycli/` package (modeled on the `deepseektui` provider), with a test file per source file (~70 cases).
- Registered in the provider factory; `antigravity_cmd` config support.
- `docs/antigravity-format-spec.md`, plus README + changelog updates.

## Testing

- Built and verified end-to-end against **real captured `agy` sessions** (interactive `run_command`, file edits/reads/search, multi-turn continuations, failed commands, and text-only sessions) via `specstory sync antigravity -s <id> --print`.
- `specstory check antigravity` detects the real binary (v1.0.2).
- `go build ./...`, `go vet ./...`, `golangci-lint run ./...` (0 issues), and `go test ./...` (all pass) are green.

33	// Check verifies that the Antigravity CLI is available and returns its resolved
34	// location and version (`agy --version` prints a bare semver such as "1.1.3").
35	func (p *Provider) Check(customCommand string) spi.CheckResult {
36		cmdName, _ := parseCommand(customCommand)
37		isCustom := strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != ""
38		slog.Info("Check: verifying Antigravity CLI installation",
39			"command", cmdName, "customCommand", isCustom)
40	
41		resolved, err := exec.LookPath(cmdName)
42		if err != nil {
43			slog.Info("Check: binary not found on PATH", "command", cmdName, "error", err)
44			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage("not_found", cmdName, isCustom, "")
45			trackCheckFailure(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, "", versionFlag, "", "not_found", err.Error())
46			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: "", ErrorMessage: msg}
47		}
48		slog.Info("Check: binary resolved", "command", cmdName, "resolved", resolved)
49	
50		var stdout, stderr bytes.Buffer
51		cmd := exec.Command(resolved, versionFlag)
52		cmd.Stdout = &stdout
53		cmd.Stderr = &stderr
54		if err := cmd.Run(); err != nil {
55			errorType := classifyCheckError(err)
56			stderrOutput := strings.TrimSpace(stderr.String())
57			slog.Info("Check: version probe failed",
58				"resolved", resolved, "errorType", errorType, "stderr", stderrOutput, "error", err)
59			msg := buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType, resolved, isCustom, stderrOutput)
60			trackCheckFailure(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, resolved, versionFlag, stderrOutput, errorType, err.Error())
61			return spi.CheckResult{Success: false, Location: resolved, ErrorMessage: msg}
62		}
63	
64		version := strings.TrimSpace(stdout.String())
65		if version == "" {
66			version = "unknown"
67		}
68		slog.Info("Check: succeeded", "resolved", resolved, "version", version)
69		trackCheckSuccess(providerID, isCustom, cmdName, resolved, version, versionFlag)
70		return spi.CheckResult{Success: true, Version: version, Location: resolved}
71	}

73	// DetectAgent reports whether the Antigravity CLI has been used in the given
74	// project, based on transcripts under ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/.
75	func (p *Provider) DetectAgent(projectPath string, helpOutput bool) bool {
76		files, err := listConversationFiles()
77		if err != nil {
78			if helpOutput {
79				log.UserWarn("Antigravity CLI detection failed: %v", err)
80			}
81			return false
82		}
83		if len(files) == 0 {
84			if helpOutput {
85				printDetectionHelp()
86			}
87			return false
88		}
89		if strings.TrimSpace(projectPath) == "" {
90			return true
91		}
92	
93		history, projectWorkspaces := loadWorkspaceIndexes()
94	
95		// Answer from the indexes first: a conversation whose workspace is already
96		// stated needs no transcript read at all, which for interactive users
97		// short-circuits before any file is opened.
98		for _, file := range files {
99			workspace := resolveSessionWorkspace(file.ConversationID, history, projectWorkspaces)
100			if workspace != "" && workspacesOverlap(workspace, projectPath) {
101				return true
102			}
103		}
104	
105		// Sessions with no stated workspace (print mode) can only be placed by the
106		// paths their tools touched, which means parsing the transcript.
107		for _, file := range files {
108			session, err := parseTranscript(file.ConversationID, file.Path, history, projectWorkspaces, false)
109			if err != nil {
110				continue
111			}
112			if sessionMatchesProject(session, projectPath) {
113				return true
114			}
115		}
116	
117		if helpOutput {
118			printDetectionHelp()
119		}
120		return false
121	}

123	// GetAgentChatSessions returns all Antigravity CLI sessions, optionally filtered
124	// to those associated with projectPath.
125	func (p *Provider) GetAgentChatSessions(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, progress spi.ProgressCallback) ([]spi.AgentChatSession, error) {
126		files, err := listConversationFiles()
127		if err != nil {
128			return nil, err
129		}
130		history, projectWorkspaces := loadWorkspaceIndexes()
131	
132		total := len(files)
133		result := make([]spi.AgentChatSession, 0, total)
134		for i, file := range files {
135			if chat := convertConversation(file, projectPath, debugRaw, history, projectWorkspaces); chat != nil {
136				result = append(result, *chat)
137			}
138			if progress != nil {
139				progress(i+1, total)
140			}
141		}
142		return result, nil
143	}

145	// convertConversation parses one conversation and converts it to the unified
146	// format, returning nil when it cannot be read or does not belong to
147	// projectPath. Keeping the per-conversation work here lets the callers report
148	// progress exactly once per file regardless of why a file was skipped.
149	func convertConversation(file conversationFile, projectPath string, debugRaw bool,
150		history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string) *spi.AgentChatSession {
151	
152		session, err := parseTranscript(file.ConversationID, file.Path, history, projectWorkspaces, true)
153		if err != nil {
154			slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session", "conversationId", file.ConversationID, "error", err)
155			return nil
156		}
157		if !sessionMatchesProject(session, projectPath) {
158			return nil
159		}
160		return convertToAgentSession(session, projectPath, debugRaw)
161	}

174		if err != nil {

180		if strings.TrimSpace(projectPath) != "" && sessionWorkspaceKnown(session) && !sessionMatchesProject(session, projectPath) {
181			return nil, nil
182		}

217	// ExecAgentAndWatch executes the Antigravity CLI for the given project and
218	// watches for transcript updates.
219	func (p *Provider) ExecAgentAndWatch(projectPath string, customCommand string, resumeSessionID string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
220		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: starting Antigravity CLI execution and monitoring",
221			"projectPath", projectPath,
222			"customCommand", customCommand,
223			"resumeSessionID", resumeSessionID,
224			"debugRaw", debugRaw,
225			"hasCallback", sessionCallback != nil)
226	
227		if sessionCallback == nil {
228			slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: no callback provided, running without watcher")
229			return ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
230		}
231	
232		ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
233		defer cancel()
234	
235		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: launching session watcher in background")
236		watchErr := make(chan error, 1)
237		go func() {
238			watchErr <- watchSessions(ctx, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback)
239		}()
240	
241		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: executing Antigravity CLI", "command", customCommand)
242		err := ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand, resumeSessionID)
243		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: Antigravity CLI exited, stopping watcher", "execError", err)
244		cancel()
245	
246		if werr := <-watchErr; werr != nil && !errors.Is(werr, context.Canceled) {
247			slog.Warn("ExecAgentAndWatch: watcher stopped with error", "error", werr)
248		}
249	
250		if err != nil {
251			return fmt.Errorf("antigravity execution failed: %w", err)
252		}
253		slog.Info("ExecAgentAndWatch: complete")
254		return nil
255	}

260		slog.Info("WatchAgent: starting Antigravity CLI activity monitoring",

270	// ListAllAgentChatSessions enumerates every Antigravity session across all
271	// projects, one ref per conversation that has a parseable transcript. Unlike the
272	// project-scoped listing, the project is discovered rather than supplied: each
273	// ref carries the session's resolved workspace as OriginCwd so `specstory
274	// reindex` can map it to a project; sessions whose workspace Antigravity never
275	// stated carry an empty OriginCwd and stay unmapped rather than guessing.
276	// Enumeration is keyed off the brain/ dirs (the transcript-backed
277	// conversations) rather than conversations/*.db, since only the former yield
278	// conversation content this provider can read. See
279	// docs/antigravity-format-spec.md §1.1.
280	func (p *Provider) ListAllAgentChatSessions() ([]spi.GlobalSessionRef, error) {
281		files, err := listConversationFiles()
282		if err != nil {
283			return nil, err
284		}
285		history, projectWorkspaces := loadWorkspaceIndexes()
286		summaries := loadSummaries()
287	
288		var refs []spi.GlobalSessionRef
289		for _, file := range files {
290			session, err := parseTranscript(file.ConversationID, file.Path, history, projectWorkspaces, false)
291			if err != nil {
292				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping session during global enumeration",
293					"conversationId", file.ConversationID, "error", err)
294				continue
295			}
296			meta := sessionMetadata(session, history, summaries)
297			if meta == nil {
298				// No user prompt — nothing resumable/indexable.
299				continue
300			}
301			refs = append(refs, spi.GlobalSessionRef{
302				SessionID:  meta.SessionID,
303				CreatedAt:  meta.CreatedAt,
304				Slug:       meta.Slug,
305				Name:       meta.Name,
306				NativePath: file.Path,
307				OriginCwd:  session.Workspace,
308			})
309		}
310		return refs, nil
311	}

313	// --- helpers shared across the package ---
314	
315	func classifyCheckError(err error) string {
316		var execErr *exec.Error
317		var pathErr *os.PathError
318		switch {
319		case errors.As(err, &execErr) && execErr.Err == exec.ErrNotFound:
320			return "not_found"
321		case errors.As(err, &pathErr) && errors.Is(pathErr.Err, os.ErrPermission):
322			return "permission_denied"
323		case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
324			return "permission_denied"
325		default:
326			return "version_failed"
327		}
328	}
329	
330	func buildCheckErrorMessage(errorType string, command string, isCustom bool, stderr string) string {
331		var builder strings.Builder
332		switch errorType {
333		case "not_found":
334			builder.WriteString("Antigravity CLI was not found.\n\n")
335			if isCustom {
336				builder.WriteString("• Verify the custom path you provided is executable.\n")
337				fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "• Provided command: %s\n", command)
338			} else {
339				builder.WriteString("• Install the Antigravity CLI and ensure `agy` is on your PATH.\n")
340				builder.WriteString("• Re-run `specstory check antigravity` after installation.\n")
341			}
342		case "permission_denied":
343			builder.WriteString("SpecStory cannot execute the Antigravity CLI due to permissions.\n\n")
344			fmt.Fprintf(&builder, "Try: chmod +x %s\n", command)
345		default:
346			builder.WriteString("`agy --version` failed.\n\n")
347			if stderr != "" {
348				builder.WriteString("Error output:\n")
349				builder.WriteString(stderr)
350				builder.WriteString("\n\n")
351			}
352			builder.WriteString("Run `agy --version` manually to diagnose, then retry.")
353		}
354		return builder.String()
355	}

357	func trackCheckSuccess(provider string, custom bool, commandPath string, resolvedPath string, version string, versionFlag string) {
358		props := analytics.Properties{
359			"provider":       provider,
360			"custom_command": custom,
361			"command_path":   commandPath,
362			"resolved_path":  resolvedPath,
363			"version":        version,
364			"version_flag":   versionFlag,
365		}
366		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallSuccess, props)
367	}

369	func trackCheckFailure(provider string, custom bool, commandPath string, resolvedPath string, versionFlag string, stderrOutput string, errorType string, message string) {
370		props := analytics.Properties{

378		}
379		if stderrOutput != "" {
380			props["stderr"] = stderrOutput
381		}
382		analytics.TrackEvent(analytics.EventCheckInstallFailed, props)
383	}

195	func parseTranscript(conversationID, transcriptPath string, history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string, wantRawData bool) (*agSession, error) {

199		}

208			line := bytes.TrimSpace(rawLine)

229		// correlation and the first/last timestamps below are computed on the true
230		// order. A stable sort keeps file order for any equal indices.
231		sort.SliceStable(steps, func(i, j int) bool {
232			return steps[i].StepIndex < steps[j].StepIndex

258	// loadTaskOutputs reads optional async command logs from
259	// .system_generated/tasks/task-<step_index>.log. Antigravity names the task log
260	// after the RUN_COMMAND result step that remains RUNNING in the transcript.
261	func loadTaskOutputs(transcriptPath string) (map[int]string, error) {
262		systemDir := filepath.Dir(filepath.Dir(transcriptPath))
263		tasksDir := filepath.Join(systemDir, "tasks")
264		entries, err := os.ReadDir(tasksDir)
265		if err != nil {
266			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
267				return nil, nil
268			}
269			return nil, err
270		}
271	
272		outputs := make(map[int]string)
273		for _, entry := range entries {
274			if entry.IsDir() {
275				continue
276			}
277			name := entry.Name()
278			if !strings.HasPrefix(name, "task-") || !strings.HasSuffix(name, ".log") {
279				continue
280			}
281			stepIndex, err := strconv.Atoi(strings.TrimSuffix(strings.TrimPrefix(name, "task-"), ".log"))
282			if err != nil {
283				continue
284			}
285			data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(tasksDir, name))
286			if err != nil {
287				continue
288			}
289			if text := strings.TrimSpace(string(data)); text != "" {
290				outputs[stepIndex] = text
291			}
292		}
293		return outputs, nil
294	}

296	// normalizeFallbackArgs unescapes the double-encoded arg values found in
297	// transcript.jsonl. Each value there is itself a JSON-encoded scalar
298	// (string→string, "false"→bool, "5000"→int); decoding it once more recovers the
299	// native value. Values that don't decode are left as-is.
300	func normalizeFallbackArgs(args map[string]any) map[string]any {
301		if len(args) == 0 {
302			return args
303		}
304		out := make(map[string]any, len(args))
305		for k, v := range args {
306			s, ok := v.(string)
307			if !ok {
308				out[k] = v
309				continue
310			}
311			var decoded any
312			if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(s), &decoded); err == nil {
313				out[k] = decoded
314			} else {
315				out[k] = s
316			}
317		}
318		return out
319	}

321	// sessionMetadata builds lightweight spi.SessionMetadata from an already-parsed
322	// session. Returns nil when the conversation has no usable user prompt — callers
323	// treat that as "skip".
324	func sessionMetadata(session *agSession, history map[string]historyEntry, summaries map[string]conversationSummary) *spi.SessionMetadata {
325		prompt := firstUserPromptText(session)
326		if prompt == "" {
327			return nil
328		}
329	
330		slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(prompt)
331		if slug == "" {
332			slug = fallbackSlug
333		}
334	
335		createdAt := session.CreatedAt
336		if createdAt == "" {
337			if entry, ok := history[session.ConversationID]; ok {
338				createdAt = msEpochToRFC3339(entry.Timestamp)
339			}
340		}
341	
342		// Prefer Antigravity's own generated conversation title/preview when present;
343		// it is a cleaner label than one derived from the raw first prompt. The
344		// summaries store is partial and async, so fall back to the derived name.
345		name := spi.GenerateReadableName(prompt)
346		if best := summaries[session.ConversationID].bestName(); best != "" {
347			name = best
348		}
349	
350		return &spi.SessionMetadata{
351			SessionID: session.ConversationID,
352			CreatedAt: createdAt,
353			Slug:      slug,
354			Name:      name,
355		}
356	}
357	
358	// firstUserPromptText returns the cleaned text of the first USER_INPUT step that
359	// carries a real prompt, or "" if none.
360	func firstUserPromptText(session *agSession) string {
361		for _, step := range session.Steps {
362			if step.Type != typeUserInput {
363				continue
364			}
365			if text := cleanUserPrompt(step.Content); text != "" {
366				return text
367			}
368		}
369		return ""
370	}

135	func buildExchanges(session *agSession, workspaceRoot string) []Exchange {

190		flush()
191	
192		for i := range exchanges {
193			exchanges[i].ExchangeID = fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d", session.ConversationID, i)
194			if exchanges[i].StartTime == "" {
195				exchanges[i].StartTime = session.CreatedAt
196			}
197			if exchanges[i].EndTime == "" {
198				exchanges[i].EndTime = exchanges[i].StartTime
199			}
200		}
201	
202		return exchanges
203	}
204	
205	// convertUserStep converts a USER_INPUT step to a schema user message, stripping
206	// the <USER_REQUEST> wrapper and metadata blocks. Returns a zero-value Message
207	// (empty Content) when nothing user-visible remains; callers drop it.
208	func convertUserStep(step transcriptStep) Message {
209		text := cleanUserPrompt(step.Content)
210		if text == "" {
211			return Message{}
212		}
213		return Message{
214			Timestamp: step.CreatedAt,
215			Role:      schema.RoleUser,
216			Content:   []ContentPart{{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: text}},
217		}
218	}
219	
220	// convertPlannerStep converts a PLANNER_RESPONSE into an ordered set of messages:
221	// an optional agent message carrying the model's thinking + reply text, followed
222	// by one message per tool call.
223	func convertPlannerStep(step transcriptStep, conversationID, model, workspaceRoot string) []Message {
224		var msgs []Message
225	
226		var parts []ContentPart
227		if thinking := strings.TrimSpace(step.Thinking); thinking != "" {
228			parts = append(parts, ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeThinking, Text: thinking})
229		}
230		if text := strings.TrimSpace(step.Content); text != "" {
231			parts = append(parts, ContentPart{Type: schema.ContentTypeText, Text: text})
232		}
233		if len(parts) > 0 {
234			msgs = append(msgs, Message{
235				Timestamp: step.CreatedAt,
236				Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
237				Model:     model,
238				Content:   parts,
239			})
240		}
241	
242		for idx, tc := range step.ToolCalls {
243			// Antigravity tool calls carry no explicit id, so synthesize a stable one
244			// from the conversation + step + tool position.
245			useID := fmt.Sprintf("%s:%d:%d", conversationID, step.StepIndex, idx)
246			msgs = append(msgs, convertToolCallMessage(tc, useID, model, step.CreatedAt, workspaceRoot))
247		}
248	
249		return msgs
250	}
251	
252	// convertToolCallMessage builds an agent Message for a single tool call. The
253	// FormattedMarkdown is set from the input here; attachToolResult re-renders it
254	// once the matching result step lands.
255	func convertToolCallMessage(tc transcriptToolCall, useID, model, timestamp, workspaceRoot string) Message {
256		name := tc.Name
257		if name == "" {
258			name = "unknown"
259		}
260		tool := &ToolInfo{
261			Name:  name,
262			Type:  classifyToolType(name),
263			UseID: useID,
264			Input: tc.Args,
265		}
266		if formatted := formatToolCall(tool); formatted != "" {
267			tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formatted
268		}
269		return Message{
270			Timestamp: timestamp,
271			Role:      schema.RoleAgent,
272			Model:     model,
273			Tool:      tool,
274			PathHints: extractPathHints(tc.Args, workspaceRoot),
275		}
276	}
277	
278	// attachToolResult routes a tool-result step's content to a pending tool message
279	// in the current exchange (one that has not yet received output). Antigravity
280	// transcripts carry no call→result id, so correlation is by tool type first
281	// (route the result to a pending call whose type matches the result's category),
282	// falling back to the oldest pending call (positional/FIFO). The type check keeps
283	// results correctly paired when several calls are in flight and complete out of
284	// order. After attaching, the tool's FormattedMarkdown is re-rendered to include
285	// the output.
286	func attachToolResult(step transcriptStep, current *Exchange, taskOutputs map[int]string) {
287		content := cleanResultContent(step)
288		if strings.EqualFold(step.Status, statusRunning) {
289			if taskOutput := strings.TrimSpace(taskOutputs[step.StepIndex]); taskOutput != "" {
290				if content != "" {
291					content += "\n\nTask output:\n" + taskOutput
292				} else {
293					content = taskOutput
294				}
295			}
296		}
297		tool := pickPendingTool(current, resultStepToolType(step.Type))
298		if tool == nil {
299			slog.Debug("antigravity: tool result with no pending tool call", "type", step.Type, "stepIndex", step.StepIndex)
300			return
301		}
302		tool.Output = map[string]any{"content": content}
303		if formatted := formatToolCall(tool); formatted != "" {
304			tool.FormattedMarkdown = &formatted
305		}
306	}
307	
308	// pickPendingTool selects the tool message a result should attach to: the oldest
309	// pending (output-less) tool whose Type equals wantType, or — when wantType is
310	// empty (ambiguous result category) or none matches — the oldest pending tool of
311	// any type. Returns nil when no tool is awaiting output.
312	func pickPendingTool(current *Exchange, wantType string) *ToolInfo {
313		var fallback *ToolInfo
314		for i := range current.Messages {
315			tool := current.Messages[i].Tool
316			if tool == nil || tool.Output != nil {
317				continue
318			}
319			if fallback == nil {
320				fallback = tool
321			}
322			if wantType != "" && tool.Type == wantType {
323				return tool
324			}
325		}
326		return fallback
327	}
328	
329	// resultStepToolType maps an Antigravity result step type to the SpecStory tool
330	// type (schema.ToolType*) the originating call carries on ToolInfo.Type, so a
331	// result can be routed to the matching pending call. Result types without a clean
332	// 1:1 mapping — GENERIC and the dedicated new-tool result types — return "", which
333	// tells pickPendingTool to fall back to positional (FIFO) attachment.
334	func resultStepToolType(resultType string) string {
335		switch resultType {
336		case typeRunCommand:
337			return schema.ToolTypeShell
338		case typeViewFile, typeListDirectory:
339			return schema.ToolTypeRead
340		case typeCodeAction:
341			return schema.ToolTypeWrite
342		case typeGrepSearch:
343			return schema.ToolTypeSearch
344		default:
345			return ""
346		}
347	}
348	
349	// resultBoilerplate are framework filler phrases agy appends to tool results.
350	// They are instructions to the model, not information for a human reader, so they
351	// are stripped from rendered output. Matched as substrings because agy sometimes
352	// appends them inline to a content line (e.g. right after "The following changes
353	// were made … to: <path>.").
354	var resultBoilerplate = []string{
355		"If relevant, proactively run terminal commands to execute this code for the USER. Don't ask for permission.",
356		"Please note that the above snippet only shows the MODIFIED lines from the last change. It shows up to 3 lines of unchanged lines before and after the modified lines. The actual file contents may have many more lines not shown.",
357		"Do not output the path of this image to show to the user since the user can already see it. However, you can embed this image in artifacts for the USER's review.",
358		"The subagents will send you a message when they have completed their task or require guidance. There is no need to poll for their responses.",
359		"You can use the view_file tool to read specific sections if needed.",
360	}
361	
362	// cleanResultContent normalizes a tool result's content for display: it strips
363	// the per-result "Created At:"/"Completed At:" timing header (redundant with the
364	// turn timestamps), the leading tab indentation agy inserts into RUN_COMMAND
365	// output blocks, and the framework boilerplate above, then collapses the blank
366	// lines those removals leave behind.
367	func cleanResultContent(step transcriptStep) string {
368		content := strings.TrimSpace(step.Content)
369		if content == "" {
370			return ""
371		}
372		for _, phrase := range resultBoilerplate {
373			content = strings.ReplaceAll(content, phrase, "")
374		}
375		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
376		kept := make([]string, 0, len(lines))
377		for _, line := range lines {
378			line = strings.TrimRight(strings.TrimLeft(line, "\t"), " \t")
379			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "Created At:") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "Completed At:") {
380				continue
381			}
382			kept = append(kept, line)
383		}
384		return collapseBlankLines(strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(kept, "\n")))
385	}
386	
387	// collapseBlankLines reduces any run of blank lines to a single blank line, so
388	// content stays readable after header/boilerplate removal opens gaps.
389	func collapseBlankLines(s string) string {
390		var b strings.Builder
391		blank := false
392		for _, line := range strings.Split(s, "\n") {
393			if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "" {
394				if blank {
395					continue
396				}
397				blank = true
398			} else {
399				blank = false
400			}
401			b.WriteString(line)
402			b.WriteString("\n")
403		}
404		return strings.TrimSpace(b.String())
405	}

407	// cleanUserPrompt extracts the real prompt from a USER_INPUT content blob.
408	func cleanUserPrompt(raw string) string {
409		if m := userRequestRe.FindStringSubmatch(raw); len(m) == 2 {
410			return strings.TrimSpace(m[1])
411		}
412		// No wrapper (defensive): drop any metadata blocks and return the remainder.
413		cleaned := metadataBlockRe.ReplaceAllString(raw, "")
414		return strings.TrimSpace(cleaned)
415	}

420			if slug := spi.GenerateFilenameFromUserMessage(prompt); slug != "" {
421				return slug

427	// deriveModel extracts the model name from the first turn's settings-change
428	// block. Returns "" when no model is recorded (e.g. continuation-only captures).
429	func deriveModel(steps []transcriptStep) string {
430		for _, step := range steps {
431			if step.Type != typeUserInput {
432				continue
433			}
434			if m := modelRe.FindStringSubmatch(step.Content); len(m) == 2 {
435				return strings.TrimSpace(m[1])
436			}
437		}
438		return ""

441	// resolveSessionWorkspace determines the workspace a conversation belongs to,
442	// using only sources that state it outright: history.jsonl (interactive
443	// sessions), then the conversationId -> projectId -> workspace join recovered
444	// from retained CLI logs. Returns "" when neither knows.
445	//
446	// A workspace is deliberately NOT inferred from the paths the session's tools
447	// touched. The common ancestor of those paths collapses to something far above
448	// the project as soon as one path falls outside it (reading ~/.gitconfig is
449	// enough to yield $HOME), and sessionMatchesProject treats a workspace that
450	// contains the project as a match — so an inferred ancestor would attach the
451	// session to every unrelated project beneath it. Sessions with no stated
452	// workspace are still matched to their project by the tool-path scan in
453	// sessionMatchesProject, which requires a path actually inside that project.
454	func resolveSessionWorkspace(conversationID string, history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string) string {
455		if entry, ok := history[conversationID]; ok {
456			if ws := strings.TrimSpace(entry.Workspace); ws != "" {
457				return ws
458			}
459		}
460		return strings.TrimSpace(projectWorkspaces[conversationID])
461	}
462	
463	// sessionWorkspaceKnown reports whether a session has any signal of which
464	// project it belongs to. Text-only print-mode sessions have neither a history
465	// entry nor tool paths, so their workspace is unknowable; such "unscoped"
466	// sessions are surfaced only on explicit by-id retrieval, never in project-
467	// filtered bulk listings (which would otherwise pollute every project).
468	func sessionWorkspaceKnown(session *agSession) bool {
469		return strings.TrimSpace(session.Workspace) != "" || len(collectToolPaths(session.Steps)) > 0
470	}
471	
472	// sessionMatchesProject reports whether a session belongs to projectPath. An
473	// empty projectPath matches every session (no filtering). A session matches when
474	// its resolved workspace and the project are nested either way, or when any tool
475	// touched a path inside the project.
476	//
477	// Matching a workspace that merely contains the project is safe because
478	// resolveSessionWorkspace only returns workspaces Antigravity stated itself —
479	// a monorepo root recorded in history.jsonl should match a sync run from one of
480	// its subdirectories.
481	func sessionMatchesProject(session *agSession, projectPath string) bool {
482		if strings.TrimSpace(projectPath) == "" {
483			return true
484		}
485		if workspacesOverlap(session.Workspace, projectPath) {
486			return true
487		}
488		for _, p := range collectToolPaths(session.Steps) {
489			if pathWithin(p, projectPath) {
490				return true
491			}
492		}
493		return false
494	}
495	
496	// workspacesOverlap reports whether a stated workspace and a project directory
497	// are the same or nested either way. Both directions count: a session recorded
498	// against a subdirectory belongs to a sync run from the repo root, and one
499	// recorded against a monorepo root belongs to a sync run from a package inside
500	// it. An empty workspace never overlaps.
501	func workspacesOverlap(workspace, projectPath string) bool {
502		if strings.TrimSpace(workspace) == "" {
503			return false
504		}
505		return pathWithin(workspace, projectPath) || pathWithin(projectPath, workspace)
506	}
507	
508	// collectToolPaths gathers the absolute filesystem paths referenced by every
509	// tool call in the transcript, normalizing file:// URIs to plain paths.
510	func collectToolPaths(steps []transcriptStep) []string {
511		var paths []string
512		seen := make(map[string]bool)
513		for _, step := range steps {
514			for _, tc := range step.ToolCalls {
515				for _, key := range toolPathArgKeys {
516					val, ok := tc.Args[key].(string)
517					if !ok {
518						continue
519					}
520					appendUniqueAbsPath(&paths, seen, val)
521				}
522			}
523		}
524		return paths
525	}
526	
527	func appendUniqueAbsPath(paths *[]string, seen map[string]bool, value string) {
528		p := stripFileURI(strings.TrimSpace(value))
529		if p == "" || !filepath.IsAbs(p) || seen[p] {
530			return
531		}
532		seen[p] = true
533		*paths = append(*paths, p)
534	}
535	
536	// stripFileURI removes a leading file:// scheme and decodes escaped path bytes
537	// so URIs like file:///tmp/my%20file.go become /tmp/my file.go.
538	func stripFileURI(value string) string {
539		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(value)
540		if !strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "file:") {
541			return trimmed
542		}
543		parsed, err := url.Parse(trimmed)
544		if err == nil && parsed.Scheme == "file" {
545			if decoded, err := url.PathUnescape(parsed.Path); err == nil {
546				return decoded
547			}
548			return parsed.Path
549		}
550		return strings.TrimPrefix(trimmed, "file://")
551	}
552	
553	// msEpochToRFC3339 converts a millisecond epoch timestamp to an RFC3339 UTC
554	// string. Returns "" for non-positive input.
555	func msEpochToRFC3339(ms int64) string {
556		if ms <= 0 {
557			return ""
558		}
559		return time.UnixMilli(ms).UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)
560	}
561	
562	// writeDebugRaw writes the raw transcript to the debug directory when --debug-raw
563	// is set. The unified session-data.json is written centrally by the CLI.
564	func writeDebugRaw(session *agSession) {
565		if session == nil || session.RawData == "" {
566			return
567		}
568		dir := spi.GetDebugDir(session.ConversationID)
569		if err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {
570			slog.Debug("antigravity: unable to create debug dir", "error", err)
571			return
572		}
573		rawPath := filepath.Join(dir, "raw-transcript.jsonl")
574		if err := os.WriteFile(rawPath, []byte(session.RawData), 0o644); err != nil {
575			slog.Debug("antigravity: failed to write debug raw file", "path", rawPath, "error", err)
576			return
577		}
578		slog.Debug("antigravity: wrote debug raw file", "conversationId", session.ConversationID, "path", rawPath)
579	}

154	// formatDiffBlockOutput reformats an agy edit-tool result — a lead sentence

203		}
204		var bullets []string
205		for _, o := range objs {
206			spec, _ := o["spec"].(map[string]any)
207			result, _ := o["result"].(map[string]any)
208			role := stringValue(spec, "role")
209			typeName := stringValue(spec, "typeName")
210			id := stringValue(result, "conversationId")
211	
212			label := role
213			if label == "" {
214				label = typeName
215			}
216			if label == "" && id == "" {
217				continue
218			}
219			line := "- "
220			if label != "" {
221				line += "**" + label + "**"
222			}
223			if typeName != "" && typeName != label {
224				line += " (`" + typeName + "`)"
225			}
226			if id != "" {
227				if label != "" {
228					line += " — "
229				}
230				line += "conversation `" + id + "`"
231			}
232			bullets = append(bullets, line)
233		}
234		if len(bullets) == 0 {
235			return ""
236		}
237		return joinOutput(defaultLead(lead, "Active subagents:"), bullets)
238	}
239	
240	// splitLeadJSON splits a tool result into its leading prose and the JSON
241	// value(s) that follow. It scans for the first line beginning a JSON object or
242	// array, treats everything before as the lead, and decodes the remainder as a
243	// stream of JSON values (tolerating agy's occasional multi-object output). It
244	// returns ok=false when no parseable JSON is present, so callers can fall back.
245	func splitLeadJSON(content string) (lead string, objs []map[string]any, ok bool) {
246		lines := strings.Split(content, "\n")
247		start := -1
248		for i, line := range lines {
249			t := strings.TrimSpace(line)
250			if strings.HasPrefix(t, "{") || strings.HasPrefix(t, "[") {
251				start = i
252				break
253			}
254		}
255		if start == -1 {
256			return "", nil, false
257		}
258		lead = strings.TrimSpace(strings.Join(lines[:start], "\n"))
259	
260		dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(strings.Join(lines[start:], "\n")))
261		for {
262			var v any
263			err := dec.Decode(&v)
264			if err == io.EOF {
265				break
266			}
267			if err != nil {
268				if len(objs) == 0 {
269					return "", nil, false
270				}
271				break // stop at the first non-JSON trailing content, keep what parsed
272			}
273			switch t := v.(type) {
274			case map[string]any:
275				objs = append(objs, t)
276			case []any:
277				for _, e := range t {
278					if m, ok := e.(map[string]any); ok {
279						objs = append(objs, m)
280					}
281				}
282			}
283		}
284		if len(objs) == 0 {
285			return "", nil, false
286		}
287		return lead, objs, true
288	}
289	
290	// defaultLead returns lead, or fallback when lead is empty.
291	func defaultLead(lead, fallback string) string {
292		if lead != "" {
293			return lead
294		}
295		return fallback
296	}
297	
298	// joinOutput assembles a summarized tool output: the "Output:" label, the lead
299	// sentence, then the bullet lines.
300	func joinOutput(lead string, bullets []string) string {
301		return fmt.Sprintf("Output: %s\n%s", lead, strings.Join(bullets, "\n"))
302	}
303	
304	// extractPathHints surfaces filesystem paths referenced by a tool's input so
305	// downstream features (cloud sync, search) can index sessions by touched files.
306	func extractPathHints(input map[string]any, workspaceRoot string) []string {
307		if input == nil {
308			return nil
309		}
310	
311		// Antigravity's own PascalCase keys come from the canonical list in
312		// agent_session.go so the two stay in step; the lowercase variants are
313		// forward-compatibility for tools we have not seen emitted.
314		pathFields := append(slices.Clone(toolPathArgKeys),
315			"path", "file_path", "file", "dir", "directory", "cwd", "workdir")
316	
317		var hints []string
318		for _, field := range pathFields {
319			val, ok := input[field]
320			if !ok {
321				continue
322			}
323			switch v := val.(type) {
324			case string:
325				addPathHint(&hints, v, workspaceRoot)
326			case []any:
327				for _, entry := range v {
328					if s, ok := entry.(string); ok {
329						addPathHint(&hints, s, workspaceRoot)
330					}
331				}
332			}
333		}
334	
335		command := stringValue(input, "CommandLine", "command", "cmd")
336		if command != "" {
337			cwd := stringValue(input, "Cwd", "workdir", "cwd")
338			if cwd == "" {
339				cwd = workspaceRoot
340			}
341			for _, sp := range spi.ExtractShellPathHints(command, cwd, workspaceRoot) {
342				addPathHint(&hints, sp, workspaceRoot)
343			}
344		}
345	
346		return hints
347	}
348	
349	func addPathHint(hints *[]string, value string, workspaceRoot string) {
350		value = stripFileURI(strings.TrimSpace(value))
351		if value == "" {
352			return
353		}
354		normalized := spi.NormalizePath(value, workspaceRoot)
355		for _, existing := range *hints {
356			if existing == normalized {
357				return
358			}
359		}
360		*hints = append(*hints, normalized)
361	}

474	// renderMultiEditInput renders a multi_replace_file_content call: the target
475	// file, the optional instruction, then one diff block per replacement chunk.
476	func renderMultiEditInput(args map[string]any) string {
477		path := stripFileURI(stringValue(args, "TargetFile", "file_path", "path", "file"))
478		chunks, _ := args["ReplacementChunks"].([]any)
479	
480		var b strings.Builder
481		if path != "" {
482			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Path: `%s`", path)
483		}
484		if instr := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(args, "Instruction")); instr != "" {
485			if b.Len() > 0 {
486				b.WriteString("\n\n")
487			}
488			b.WriteString(instr)
489		}
490	
491		var diffs []string
492		for _, raw := range chunks {
493			chunk, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
494			if chunk == nil {
495				continue
496			}
497			oldText := stringValue(chunk, "TargetContent")
498			newText := stringValue(chunk, "ReplacementContent")
499			if oldText == "" && newText == "" {
500				continue
501			}
502			diffs = append(diffs, formatDiffBlock(oldText, newText))
503		}
504		if len(diffs) > 0 {
505			if b.Len() > 0 {
506				b.WriteString("\n\n")
507			}
508			b.WriteString(strings.Join(diffs, "\n\n"))
509		}
510	
511		if b.Len() == 0 {
512			return renderGenericJSON(args)
513		}
514		return b.String()
515	}

523		if prompt == "" && name == "" {
524			return renderGenericJSON(args)
525		}
526	
527		var parts []string
528		switch {
529		case name != "" && aspect != "":
530			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Image: `%s` (aspect ratio `%s`)", name, aspect))
531		case name != "":
532			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Image: `%s`", name))
533		case aspect != "":
534			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Aspect ratio: `%s`", aspect))
535		}
536		if prompt != "" {
537			parts = append(parts, "Prompt: "+prompt)
538		}
539		return strings.Join(parts, "\n\n")
540	}

572	// renderInvokeSubagentInput renders an invoke_subagent call as a bullet per
573	// spawned subagent: its role, type, model, and prompt.
574	func renderInvokeSubagentInput(args map[string]any) string {
575		subs, _ := args["Subagents"].([]any)
576		if len(subs) == 0 {
577			return renderGenericJSON(args)
578		}
579	
580		var b strings.Builder
581		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "Invoking %d subagent(s):\n", len(subs))
582		for _, raw := range subs {
583			sub, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
584			if sub == nil {
585				continue
586			}
587			role := stringValue(sub, "Role", "role")
588			typeName := stringValue(sub, "TypeName", "type_name")
589			model := stringValue(sub, "Model", "model")
590			prompt := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(sub, "Prompt", "prompt"))
591	
592			label := role
593			if label == "" {
594				label = typeName
595			}
596			var meta []string
597			if typeName != "" && typeName != label {
598				meta = append(meta, "`"+typeName+"`")
599			}
600			if model != "" {
601				meta = append(meta, "model `"+model+"`")
602			}
603	
604			line := "- **" + label + "**"
605			if len(meta) > 0 {
606				line += " (" + strings.Join(meta, ", ") + ")"
607			}
608			if prompt != "" {
609				line += ": " + prompt
610			}
611			b.WriteString(line + "\n")
612		}
613		return strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
614	}

616	// renderManageInput renders an Action-based management call (manage_task,
617	// manage_subagents): the action verb and the target ids it operates on. idKeys
618	// lists the argument keys that may carry the target id(s), each a string or a
619	// list of strings.
620	func renderManageInput(args map[string]any, idLabel string, idKeys ...string) string {
621		var parts []string
622		if action := stringValue(args, "Action", "action"); action != "" {
623			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("Action: `%s`", action))
624		}
625		if ids := collectStringList(args, idKeys...); len(ids) > 0 {
626			quoted := make([]string, len(ids))
627			for i, id := range ids {
628				quoted[i] = "`" + id + "`"
629			}
630			parts = append(parts, fmt.Sprintf("%s: %s", idLabel, strings.Join(quoted, ", ")))
631		}
632		if len(parts) == 0 {
633			return renderGenericJSON(args)
634		}
635		return strings.Join(parts, "\n")
636	}

681	// renderAskQuestionInput renders an ask_question call: each question in bold
682	// followed by its selectable options as a bullet list. The user's answer arrives
683	// in the tool output and is rendered by formatToolOutput.
684	func renderAskQuestionInput(args map[string]any) string {
685		questions, _ := args["questions"].([]any)
686		if len(questions) == 0 {
687			return renderGenericJSON(args)
688		}
689	
690		var b strings.Builder
691		for qi, raw := range questions {
692			q, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
693			if q == nil {
694				continue
695			}
696			text := strings.TrimSpace(stringValue(q, "question"))
697			if text == "" {
698				continue
699			}
700			if qi > 0 {
701				b.WriteString("\n")
702			}
703			fmt.Fprintf(&b, "**%s**", text)
704			if multi, ok := q["is_multi_select"].(bool); ok && multi {
705				b.WriteString(" _(select multiple)_")
706			}
707			b.WriteString("\n")
708			options, _ := q["options"].([]any)
709			for _, opt := range options {
710				if s, ok := opt.(string); ok {
711					fmt.Fprintf(&b, "- %s\n", s)
712				}
713			}
714		}
715		out := strings.TrimRight(b.String(), "\n")
716		if out == "" {
717			return renderGenericJSON(args)
718		}
719		return out
720	}
721	
722	func formatDiffBlock(oldText, newText string) string {
723		var b strings.Builder
724		b.WriteString("```diff\n")
725		if oldText != "" {
726			for _, line := range strings.Split(oldText, "\n") {
727				b.WriteString("-")
728				b.WriteString(line)
729				b.WriteString("\n")
730			}
731		}
732		if newText != "" {
733			for _, line := range strings.Split(newText, "\n") {
734				b.WriteString("+")
735				b.WriteString(line)
736				b.WriteString("\n")
737			}
738		}
739		b.WriteString("```")
740		return b.String()
741	}
742	
743	func formatContentBlock(content, path string) string {
744		lang := languageFromPath(path)
745		escaped := strings.ReplaceAll(content, "```", "\\```")
746		if lang == "" {
747			return fmt.Sprintf("```\n%s\n```", escaped)
748		}
749		return fmt.Sprintf("```%s\n%s\n```", lang, escaped)
750	}
751	
752	func languageFromPath(path string) string {
753		if path == "" {
754			return ""
755		}
756		ext := strings.TrimPrefix(strings.ToLower(filepath.Ext(path)), ".")
757		if ext == "" {
758			return ""
759		}
760		switch ext {
761		case "yml":
762			return "yaml"
763		case "md":
764			return "markdown"
765		default:
766			return ext
767		}
768	}
769	
770	// --- generic helpers ---
771	
772	func renderGenericJSON(args map[string]any) string {
773		keys := make([]string, 0, len(args))
774		for k := range args {
775			// toolAction/toolSummary are agy-injected human labels present on every
776			// call, not real arguments; drop them so the fallback shows only real args.
777			if k == "toolAction" || k == "toolSummary" {
778				continue
779			}
780			keys = append(keys, k)
781		}
782		if len(keys) == 0 {
783			return ""
784		}
785		sort.Strings(keys)
786		var b strings.Builder
787		b.WriteString("```json\n{")
788		for i, k := range keys {
789			if i > 0 {
790				b.WriteString(",")
791			}
792			b.WriteString("\n  \"")
793			b.WriteString(k)
794			b.WriteString("\": ")
795			b.WriteString(renderJSONValue(args[k]))
796		}
797		b.WriteString("\n}\n```")
798		return b.String()
799	}
800	
801	func renderJSONValue(v any) string {
802		switch val := v.(type) {
803		case string:
804			bytes, _ := json.Marshal(val)
805			return string(bytes)
806		case json.Number:
807			return val.String()
808		default:
809			bytes, err := json.Marshal(val)
810			if err != nil {
811				return fmt.Sprintf("%q", fmt.Sprint(val))
812			}
813			return string(bytes)
814		}
815	}
816	
817	// collectStringList gathers string values from args across the given keys. Each
818	// key's value may be a single string or a list of strings; empties are skipped.
819	func collectStringList(args map[string]any, keys ...string) []string {
820		var out []string
821		for _, key := range keys {
822			val, ok := args[key]
823			if !ok {
824				continue
825			}
826			switch v := val.(type) {
827			case string:
828				if v != "" {
829					out = append(out, v)
830				}
831			case []any:
832				for _, entry := range v {
833					if s, ok := entry.(string); ok && s != "" {
834						out = append(out, s)
835					}
836				}
837			}
838		}
839		return out
840	}
841	
842	// blockquote prefixes each line of text with "> " so multi-line prompts render as
843	// a markdown blockquote.
844	func blockquote(text string) string {
845		lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(text), "\n")
846		for i, line := range lines {
847			lines[i] = "> " + line
848		}
849		return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
850	}
851	
852	func stringValue(args map[string]any, keys ...string) string {
853		for _, key := range keys {
854			val, ok := args[key]
855			if !ok {
856				continue
857			}
858			switch v := val.(type) {
859			case string:
860				return v
861			case json.Number:
862				return v.String()
863			case float64:
864				return strconv.FormatFloat(v, 'f', -1, 64)
865			case int:
866				return strconv.Itoa(v)
867			case int64:
868				return strconv.FormatInt(v, 10)
869			case bool:
870				return strconv.FormatBool(v)
871			}
872		}
873		return ""
874	}
875	
876	func normalizeToolName(name string) string {
877		cleaned := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(name))
878		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, " ", "")
879		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "-", "")
880		cleaned = strings.ReplaceAll(cleaned, "_", "")
881		return cleaned
882	}

36	// brain dir name) rather than a flat file name.
37	type conversationFile struct {

40		ModTime        int64  // UnixNano, used for change detection in the watcher
41	}

43	// resolveAntigravityDir returns the path to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli.
44	func resolveAntigravityDir() (string, error) {
45		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
46		if err != nil {
47			return "", fmt.Errorf("antigravity: cannot resolve home dir: %w", err)
48		}
49		return filepath.Join(home, geminiRootDir, antigravityDirName), nil
50	}
51	
52	// resolveBrainDir returns the path to ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain, the
53	// directory that holds one subdirectory per conversation.
54	func resolveBrainDir() (string, error) {
55		base, err := resolveAntigravityDir()
56		if err != nil {
57			return "", err
58		}
59		return filepath.Join(base, brainDirName), nil

63	func resolveHistoryPath() (string, error) {

66			return "", err

71	// transcriptDirFor returns the directory that directly contains a conversation's
72	// transcript file. The watcher must add a watch on this exact directory because
73	// fsnotify is non-recursive and only reports events for a watched dir's direct
74	// children.
75	func transcriptDirFor(conversationID string) (string, error) {
76		brain, err := resolveBrainDir()
77		if err != nil {
78			return "", err
79		}
80		return filepath.Join(brain, conversationID, systemGeneratedDir, logsDirName), nil

83	// resolveTranscriptPath returns the best transcript file for a conversation,
84	// preferring transcript_full.jsonl and falling back to transcript.jsonl. It
85	// returns ("", nil) when neither file exists (i.e. not a usable conversation).
86	func resolveTranscriptPath(conversationID string) (string, error) {
87		dir, err := transcriptDirFor(conversationID)
88		if err != nil {
89			return "", err
90		}
91	
92		primary := filepath.Join(dir, transcriptFileName)
93		if _, err := os.Stat(primary); err == nil {
94			return primary, nil
95		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
96			return "", err
97		}
98	
99		fallback := filepath.Join(dir, fallbackTranscriptFileName)
100		if _, err := os.Stat(fallback); err == nil {
101			return fallback, nil
102		} else if !os.IsNotExist(err) {
103			return "", err
104		}
105	
106		return "", nil
107	}
108	
109	// listConversationFiles returns every conversation that has a readable
110	// transcript, sorted newest-first by transcript modification time. A missing
111	// brain directory is not an error — it just means Antigravity hasn't run yet.
112	func listConversationFiles() ([]conversationFile, error) {
113		brain, err := resolveBrainDir()
114		if err != nil {
115			return nil, err
116		}
117	
118		entries, err := os.ReadDir(brain)
119		if err != nil {
120			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
121				return []conversationFile{}, nil
122			}
123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: unable to read brain dir: %w", err)
124		}
125	
126		var files []conversationFile
127		for _, entry := range entries {
128			if !entry.IsDir() {
129				continue
130			}
131			conversationID := entry.Name()
132	
133			path, err := resolveTranscriptPath(conversationID)
134			if err != nil {
135				continue
136			}
137			if path == "" {
138				continue
139			}
140	
141			info, err := os.Stat(path)
142			if err != nil {
143				continue
144			}
145	
146			files = append(files, conversationFile{
147				ConversationID: conversationID,
148				Path:           path,
149				ModTime:        info.ModTime().UnixNano(),
150			})
151		}
152	
153		sort.Slice(files, func(i, j int) bool {
154			return files[i].ModTime > files[j].ModTime
155		})
156	
157		return files, nil
158	}

160	// canonicalizePath resolves a path to its canonical form for comparison, so that
161	// symlinks and case-insensitive filesystems (macOS) compare equal.
162	func canonicalizePath(path string) string {
163		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(path)
164		if trimmed == "" {
165			return ""
166		}
167		if canonical, err := spi.GetCanonicalPath(trimmed); err == nil {
168			return canonical
169		}
170		if abs, err := filepath.Abs(trimmed); err == nil {
171			return filepath.Clean(abs)
172		}
173		return filepath.Clean(trimmed)
174	}
175	
176	// pathWithin reports whether candidate is equal to or nested inside root, after
177	// canonicalizing both. Used to match a session's touched files against the
178	// project path the user is syncing from.
179	func pathWithin(candidate, root string) bool {
180		cRoot := canonicalizePath(root)
181		cCandidate := canonicalizePath(candidate)
182		if cRoot == "" || cCandidate == "" {
183			return false
184		}
185		if cCandidate == cRoot {
186			return true
187		}
188		rel, err := filepath.Rel(cRoot, cCandidate)
189		if err != nil {
190			return false
191		}
192		return rel != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rel, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))
193	}

158	// loadProjectWorkspaceIndex maps Antigravity project IDs to workspace roots from
159	// ~/.gemini/config/projects/*.json.
160	func loadProjectWorkspaceIndex() (map[string]string, error) {
161		dir, err := resolveGeminiProjectsDir()
162		if err != nil {
163			return nil, err
164		}
165		entries, err := os.ReadDir(dir)
166		if err != nil {
167			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
168				return map[string]string{}, nil
169			}
170			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: unable to read projects dir: %w", err)
171		}
172	
173		index := make(map[string]string)
174		for _, entry := range entries {
175			if entry.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(entry.Name()) != ".json" {
176				continue
177			}
178			path := filepath.Join(dir, entry.Name())
179			data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
180			if err != nil {
181				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping unreadable project config", "path", path, "error", err)
182				continue
183			}
184			var project antigravityProjectFile
185			if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &project); err != nil {
186				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping malformed project config", "path", path, "error", err)
187				continue
188			}
189			id := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(project.ID))
190			if id == "" {
191				id = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSuffix(entry.Name(), filepath.Ext(entry.Name())))
192			}
193			workspace := projectWorkspacePath(project)
194			if id == "" || workspace == "" {
195				continue
196			}
197			index[id] = workspace
198		}
199		return index, nil
200	}
201	
202	// projectWorkspacePath extracts the workspace root from a project config,
203	// preferring the git folder, then any plain folder URI or path on the resource.
204	func projectWorkspacePath(project antigravityProjectFile) string {
205		for _, resource := range project.ProjectResources.Resources {
206			for _, candidate := range []string{
207				resource.GitFolder.FolderURI,
208				resource.FolderURI,
209				resource.Path,
210			} {
211				if path := cleanWorkspacePath(candidate); path != "" {
212					return path
213				}
214			}
215		}
216		// Projects created by the CLI (rather than the IDE) have an empty resources
217		// array and carry the workspace in `name`, which for those entries is the
218		// absolute path rather than a display label. cleanWorkspacePath rejects
219		// anything that is not an absolute path, so a genuine label is ignored here.
220		if path := cleanWorkspacePath(project.Name); path != "" {
221			return path
222		}
223		return ""
224	}
225	
226	// cleanWorkspacePath normalizes a configured workspace value, returning "" for
227	// anything that is not an absolute filesystem path.
228	func cleanWorkspacePath(value string) string {
229		path := filepath.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(stripFileURI(value)))
230		if path == "." || !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
231			return ""
232		}
233		return path
234	}
235	
236	// loadConversationWorkspaceIndex maps Antigravity conversation IDs to workspace
237	// roots by joining CLI log conversation/project IDs to config/projects/*.json.
238	func loadConversationWorkspaceIndex() (map[string]string, error) {
239		projectWorkspaces, err := loadProjectWorkspaceIndex()
240		if err != nil {
241			return nil, err
242		}
243		conversationProjects, err := loadConversationProjectIndex()
244		if err != nil {
245			return nil, err
246		}
247	
248		index := make(map[string]string)
249		for conversationID, projectID := range conversationProjects {
250			if workspace := strings.TrimSpace(projectWorkspaces[projectID]); workspace != "" {
251				index[conversationID] = workspace
252			}
253		}
254		return index, nil
255	}
256	
257	// loadConversationProjectIndex maps conversation IDs to Antigravity project IDs
258	// by scraping every retained CLI log. A missing log dir is not an error — it
259	// just means no conversation can be placed this way.
260	func loadConversationProjectIndex() (map[string]string, error) {
261		logDir, err := resolveAntigravityLogDir()
262		if err != nil {
263			return nil, err
264		}
265		entries, err := os.ReadDir(logDir)
266		if err != nil {
267			if os.IsNotExist(err) {
268				return map[string]string{}, nil
269			}
270			return nil, fmt.Errorf("antigravity: unable to read log dir: %w", err)
271		}
272	
273		index := make(map[string]string)
274		for _, entry := range entries {
275			if entry.IsDir() || filepath.Ext(entry.Name()) != ".log" {
276				continue
277			}
278			path := filepath.Join(logDir, entry.Name())
279			if err := indexConversationProjectsFromLog(path, index); err != nil {
280				slog.Debug("antigravity: skipping CLI log for project mapping", "path", path, "error", err)
281			}
282		}
283		return index, nil
284	}
285	
286	// indexConversationProjectsFromLog scans one CLI log, attributing each
287	// conversation id it sees to the most recently logged project id. agy logs the
288	// two in either order, so ids seen before any project line are held pending and
289	// attributed to the next project line encountered.
290	func indexConversationProjectsFromLog(path string, index map[string]string) error {
291		f, err := os.Open(path)
292		if err != nil {
293			return err
294		}
295		defer func() { _ = f.Close() }()
296	
297		var currentProjectID string
298		var pendingConversationIDs []string
299		scanner := bufio.NewScanner(f)
300		scanner.Buffer(make([]byte, 0, 64*1024), maxTranscriptLineSize)
301		for scanner.Scan() {
302			line := scanner.Text()
303			if projectID := projectIDFromLogLine(line); projectID != "" {
304				currentProjectID = projectID
305				for _, conversationID := range pendingConversationIDs {
306					index[conversationID] = currentProjectID
307				}
308				pendingConversationIDs = nil
309			}
310			for _, conversationID := range conversationIDsFromLogLine(line) {
311				if currentProjectID == "" {
312					pendingConversationIDs = append(pendingConversationIDs, conversationID)
313					continue
314				}
315				index[conversationID] = currentProjectID
316			}
317		}
318		return scanner.Err()
319	}
320	
321	func projectIDFromLogLine(line string) string {
322		for _, re := range []*regexp.Regexp{projectIDFromConversationRe, projectIDFromUsingRe} {
323			if m := re.FindStringSubmatch(line); len(m) == 2 {
324				return strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m[1]))
325			}
326		}
327		return ""
328	}
329	
330	func conversationIDsFromLogLine(line string) []string {
331		var ids []string
332		seen := make(map[string]bool)
333		for _, re := range conversationIDLogRes {
334			for _, m := range re.FindAllStringSubmatch(line, -1) {
335				if len(m) != 2 {
336					continue
337				}
338				id := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(m[1]))
339				if id == "" || seen[id] {
340					continue
341				}
342				seen[id] = true
343				ids = append(ids, id)
344			}
345		}
346		return ids
347	}
348

1	package antigravitycli
2	
3	import (

6		"os/exec"
7		"path/filepath"
8		"slices"
9		"strings"
10	
11		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
12	)
13	
14	const (
15		// defaultCommand is the Antigravity CLI launcher. The installed binary is
16		// `agy` (an `antigravity` alias exists but is not normally on PATH).
17		defaultCommand = "agy"
18		versionFlag    = "--version"
19		// resumeFlag continues a specific conversation by id; `-c` (most recent) is
20		// the alternative the CLI offers but we always target a known id.
21		resumeFlag = "--conversation"
22	)
23	
24	// expandTilde expands a leading ~ to the user's home directory so users can
25	// configure custom commands like "~/bin/agy".
26	func expandTilde(path string) string {
27		if !strings.HasPrefix(path, "~/") {
28			return path
29		}
30		home, err := os.UserHomeDir()
31		if err != nil {
32			return path
33		}
34		return filepath.Join(home, path[2:])
35	}
36	
37	// parseCommand splits a custom command string into executable name and args,
38	// returning the default command when customCommand is empty.
39	func parseCommand(customCommand string) (string, []string) {
40		if strings.TrimSpace(customCommand) != "" {
41			parts := spi.SplitCommandLine(customCommand)
42			if len(parts) > 0 {
43				return expandTilde(parts[0]), parts[1:]
44			}
45		}
46		return defaultCommand, nil
47	}
48	
49	// ExecuteAntigravity launches the Antigravity CLI and blocks until it exits.
50	func ExecuteAntigravity(customCommand string, resumeSessionID string) error {
51		cmdName, args := parseCommand(customCommand)
52		args = ensureResumeArgs(args, resumeSessionID)
53		if resumeSessionID != "" {
54			slog.Info("ExecuteAntigravity: resuming conversation", "conversationId", resumeSessionID)
55		}
56	
57		command := exec.Command(cmdName, args...)
58		command.Stdin = os.Stdin
59		command.Stdout = os.Stdout
60		command.Stderr = os.Stderr
61	
62		return command.Run()
63	}
64	
65	// ensureResumeArgs adds --conversation <id> to args when resuming, unless the
66	// caller already supplied a conversation flag with a value.
67	func ensureResumeArgs(args []string, resumeSessionID string) []string {
68		if resumeSessionID == "" {
69			return args
70		}
71	
72		for i, arg := range args {
73			if arg == resumeFlag {
74				if i+1 < len(args) && strings.TrimSpace(args[i+1]) != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(args[i+1], "-") {
75					return args
76				}
77				// slices.Concat always allocates a new backing array, so the caller's
78				// slice is never mutated.
79				return slices.Concat(args[:i+1], []string{resumeSessionID}, args[i+1:])
80			}
81			if strings.HasPrefix(arg, resumeFlag+"=") {
82				if strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(arg, resumeFlag+"=")) != "" {
83					return args
84				}
85				repaired := slices.Clone(args)
86				repaired[i] = resumeFlag + "=" + resumeSessionID
87				return repaired
88			}
89		}
90	
91		return append(args, resumeFlag, resumeSessionID)
92	}
93

8	// Compile-time assertion that Provider satisfies the full spi.Provider contract.
9	// The interface conformance is otherwise only exercised at registration in the
10	// factory package, so a locally missing method fails there rather than here;
11	// this guard surfaces the gap in the provider's own package.
12	var _ spi.Provider = (*Provider)(nil)
13	
14	// ReconstructSession is unsupported for Antigravity. On resume, `agy` rebuilds
15	// conversation state from the per-conversation SQLite store
16	// (conversations/<id>.db, protobuf step payloads) — NOT from the plaintext
17	// transcript this provider parses (verified empirically; see
18	// docs/antigravity-format-spec.md §1.1). A resumable reconstruction would
19	// therefore have to synthesize that protobuf-in-SQLite store, so the
20	// text-serializer approach the other providers use cannot produce a session
21	// `agy` will actually resume. Until such a serializer exists, this provider
22	// carries the interface method but declines to reconstruct.
23	func (p *Provider) ReconstructSession(data *schema.SessionData, opts spi.ReconstructOptions) (*spi.ReconstructedSession, error) {
24		return nil, spi.ErrReconstructionUnsupported
25	}
26	
27	// NativeSessionPath is unsupported for the same reason as ReconstructSession:
28	// there is no plaintext session file this provider can write that `agy` would
29	// resume from, so there is no native path to resolve.
30	func (p *Provider) NativeSessionPath(projectPath string, filename string) (string, error) {
31		return "", spi.ErrReconstructionUnsupported
32	}

1	package antigravitycli
2	
3	import (
4		"context"
5		"fmt"
6		"log/slog"
7		"os"
8		"path/filepath"
9	
10		"github.com/fsnotify/fsnotify"
11		"github.com/specstoryai/getspecstory/specstory-cli/pkg/spi"
12	)
13	
14	// watchState tracks the last-processed modification time per transcript file so
15	// the same content is not re-emitted on every filesystem event, and the set of
16	// directories already handed to fsnotify so re-establishing watches after each
17	// directory creation stays cheap.
18	type watchState struct {
19		lastProcessed map[string]int64
20		watchedDirs   map[string]bool
21	}
22	
23	func newWatchState() *watchState {
24		return &watchState{
25			lastProcessed: make(map[string]int64),
26			watchedDirs:   make(map[string]bool),
27		}
28	}
29	
30	// watchSessions watches Antigravity CLI transcripts for new or modified content
31	// and invokes sessionCallback for each change. Antigravity stores each
32	// conversation's transcript deep under brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/, and
33	// fsnotify is non-recursive, so we maintain a watch on the brain directory plus
34	// each nested directory level and extend the watches as new ones appear.
35	func watchSessions(ctx context.Context, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession)) error {
36		if sessionCallback == nil {
37			return fmt.Errorf("session callback is required")
38		}
39	
40		brainDir, err := resolveBrainDir()
41		if err != nil {
42			return err
43		}
44	
45		watcher, err := fsnotify.NewWatcher()
46		if err != nil {
47			return fmt.Errorf("antigravity: failed to create watcher: %w", err)
48		}
49		defer func() { _ = watcher.Close() }()
50	
51		state := newWatchState()
52	
53		// Initial scan so existing sessions are emitted immediately.
54		if err := scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state); err != nil {
55			slog.Debug("antigravity: initial scan failed", "error", err)
56		}
57	
58		if err := setupWatches(watcher, brainDir, state); err != nil {
59			slog.Debug("antigravity: setup watches failed", "error", err)
60		}
61	
62		for {
63			select {
64			case <-ctx.Done():
65				return ctx.Err()
66			case event, ok := <-watcher.Events:
67				if !ok {
68					return nil
69				}
70				handleWatchEvent(event, watcher, brainDir, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state)
71			case err, ok := <-watcher.Errors:
72				if !ok {
73					return nil
74				}
75				slog.Debug("antigravity: watcher error", "error", err)
76			}
77		}
78	}
79	
80	// setupWatches (re)establishes the watch set. If the brain directory does not
81	// exist yet it watches the nearest existing ancestor so brain/ creation is
82	// noticed; otherwise it watches brain/ and every nested conversation directory
83	// level that currently exists. It is safe to call on every relevant event:
84	// directories already watched are skipped via state.watchedDirs, so a re-scan
85	// during an active session costs one ReadDir rather than an fsnotify.Add per
86	// conversation.
87	func setupWatches(watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string, state *watchState) error {
88		if _, err := os.Stat(brainDir); os.IsNotExist(err) {
89			ancestor := nearestExistingDir(filepath.Dir(brainDir))
90			if ancestor == "" {
91				return nil
92			}
93			slog.Debug("antigravity: brain dir missing, watching ancestor", "path", ancestor)
94			return addWatch(watcher, state, ancestor)
95		}
96	
97		if err := addWatch(watcher, state, brainDir); err != nil {
98			return err
99		}
100		addConversationWatches(watcher, brainDir, state)
101		return nil
102	}
103	
104	// addWatch registers dir with the watcher unless it is already watched.
105	func addWatch(watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, state *watchState, dir string) error {
106		if state.watchedDirs[dir] {
107			return nil
108		}
109		if err := watcher.Add(dir); err != nil {
110			return err
111		}
112		state.watchedDirs[dir] = true
113		return nil
114	}
115	
116	// addConversationWatches adds a watch on each existing nested directory level of
117	// every conversation (<id>, <id>/.system_generated, and the logs dir that
118	// directly holds the transcript). Levels that don't exist yet are added later as
119	// their parent's Create event arrives.
120	func addConversationWatches(watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string, state *watchState) {
121		entries, err := os.ReadDir(brainDir)
122		if err != nil {
123			// Without this listing no conversation is watched at all, so surface it.
124			slog.Debug("antigravity: cannot list brain dir for watches", "path", brainDir, "error", err)
125			return
126		}
127		for _, entry := range entries {
128			if !entry.IsDir() {
129				continue
130			}
131			idDir := filepath.Join(brainDir, entry.Name())
132			levels := []string{
133				idDir,
134				filepath.Join(idDir, systemGeneratedDir),
135				filepath.Join(idDir, systemGeneratedDir, logsDirName),
136			}
137			for _, dir := range levels {
138				if state.watchedDirs[dir] {
139					continue
140				}
141				if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err != nil || !info.IsDir() {
142					continue
143				}
144				if err := addWatch(watcher, state, dir); err != nil {
145					slog.Debug("antigravity: cannot watch transcript dir", "path", dir, "error", err)
146				}
147			}
148		}
149	}
150	
151	// nearestExistingDir walks up from dir and returns the first existing directory,
152	// or "" if none is found before reaching the filesystem root.
153	func nearestExistingDir(dir string) string {
154		for dir != "" && dir != "." {
155			if info, err := os.Stat(dir); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
156				return dir
157			}
158			parent := filepath.Dir(dir)
159			if parent == dir {
160				return ""
161			}
162			dir = parent
163		}
164		return ""
165	}
166	
167	// handleWatchEvent processes a filesystem event: directory creation extends the
168	// watch set (and triggers a scan when the brain dir itself appears), while a
169	// transcript write/create is parsed and dispatched.
170	func handleWatchEvent(event fsnotify.Event, watcher *fsnotify.Watcher, brainDir string, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) {
171		slog.Debug("antigravity: received fs event", "op", event.Op.String(), "path", event.Name)
172	
173		// fsnotify drops the watch on a directory that goes away. Forget it so a
174		// path that is recreated later (or renamed into place) is watched again
175		// rather than being skipped as already-watched.
176		if event.Has(fsnotify.Remove) || event.Has(fsnotify.Rename) {
177			delete(state.watchedDirs, event.Name)
178		}
179	
180		if event.Has(fsnotify.Create) {
181			if info, err := os.Stat(event.Name); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
182				// A new directory appeared somewhere in the chain (possibly brain/
183				// itself, or a new conversation's nested dirs). Re-establish watches
184				// so the eventual transcript write is caught.
185				if err := setupWatches(watcher, brainDir, state); err != nil {
186					slog.Debug("antigravity: re-setup watches failed", "error", err)
187				}
188				if event.Name == brainDir {
189					if err := scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state); err != nil {
190						slog.Debug("antigravity: scan after brain create failed", "error", err)
191					}
192				}
193				return
194			}
195		}
196	
197		if !isTranscriptPath(event.Name) {
198			return
199		}
200		if !event.Has(fsnotify.Create) && !event.Has(fsnotify.Write) {
201			return
202		}
203		processTranscriptFile(event.Name, projectPath, debugRaw, sessionCallback, state)
204	}
205	
206	// isTranscriptPath reports whether a path is a conversation transcript file.
207	func isTranscriptPath(path string) bool {
208		base := filepath.Base(path)
209		return base == transcriptFileName || base == fallbackTranscriptFileName
210	}
211	
212	// conversationIDFromTranscriptPath recovers the conversation id (the brain
213	// subdirectory name) from a transcript path of the form
214	// brain/<id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript_full.jsonl.
215	func conversationIDFromTranscriptPath(transcriptPath string) string {
216		logsDir := filepath.Dir(transcriptPath)
217		sysDir := filepath.Dir(logsDir)
218		idDir := filepath.Dir(sysDir)
219		return filepath.Base(idDir)
220	}
221	
222	// processTranscriptFile parses and dispatches a single transcript if it changed
223	// since last processed and matches the project filter.
224	func processTranscriptFile(transcriptPath string, projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) {
225		conversationID := conversationIDFromTranscriptPath(transcriptPath)
226		if conversationID == "" {
227			return
228		}
229	
230		// An event may fire on the fallback transcript while the richer
231		// transcript_full.jsonl also exists; always emit from the preferred file.
232		preferredPath, err := resolveTranscriptPath(conversationID)
233		if err != nil {
234			slog.Debug("antigravity: unable to resolve preferred transcript", "conversationId", conversationID, "error", err)
235			return
236		}
237		if preferredPath == "" {
238			return
239		}
240	
241		info, err := os.Stat(preferredPath)
242		if err != nil {
243			slog.Debug("antigravity: cannot stat transcript", "path", preferredPath, "error", err)
244			return
245		}
246	
247		history, projectWorkspaces := loadWorkspaceIndexes()
248		emitConversation(conversationFile{
249			ConversationID: conversationID,
250			Path:           preferredPath,
251			ModTime:        info.ModTime().UnixNano(),
252		}, projectPath, debugRaw, history, projectWorkspaces, sessionCallback, state)
253	}
254	
255	// scanAndProcessConversations processes every conversation that has changed
256	// since last seen.
257	func scanAndProcessConversations(projectPath string, debugRaw bool, sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) error {
258		files, err := listConversationFiles()
259		if err != nil {
260			return err
261		}
262		history, projectWorkspaces := loadWorkspaceIndexes()
263	
264		for _, file := range files {
265			emitConversation(file, projectPath, debugRaw, history, projectWorkspaces, sessionCallback, state)
266		}
267		return nil
268	}
269	
270	// emitConversation dispatches one conversation to the callback when it has
271	// changed since it was last seen and belongs to the project being watched.
272	// Both the event-driven and scanning paths funnel through here so they cannot
273	// drift apart on what counts as new or in-project.
274	func emitConversation(file conversationFile, projectPath string, debugRaw bool,
275		history map[string]historyEntry, projectWorkspaces map[string]string,
276		sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), state *watchState) {
277	
278		if last, ok := state.lastProcessed[file.Path]; ok && last >= file.ModTime {
279			return
280		}
281		chat := convertConversation(file, projectPath, debugRaw, history, projectWorkspaces)
282		if chat == nil {
283			return
284		}
285		state.lastProcessed[file.Path] = file.ModTime
286		dispatchSession(sessionCallback, chat)
287	}
288	
289	// dispatchSession invokes the session callback in a goroutine with panic
290	// recovery so a misbehaving callback cannot crash the watcher.
291	func dispatchSession(sessionCallback func(*spi.AgentChatSession), session *spi.AgentChatSession) {
292		if sessionCallback == nil || session == nil {
293			return
294		}
295		go func() {
296			defer func() {
297				if r := recover(); r != nil {
298					slog.Error("antigravity: session callback panicked", "panic", r)
299				}
300			}()
301			sessionCallback(session)
302		}()
303	}
304

163	func TestAttachToolResult_FIFOAndOrphan(t *testing.T) {
164		// Two pending tool calls; two results should attach in order (FIFO).
165		current := &Exchange{Messages: []Message{
166			{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &ToolInfo{Name: "run_command", Input: map[string]any{"CommandLine": "a"}}},
167			{Role: schema.RoleAgent, Tool: &ToolInfo{Name: "run_command", Input: map[string]any{"CommandLine": "b"}}},
168		}}
169	
170		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "result-A"}, current, nil)
171		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "result-B"}, current, nil)
172	
173		if out, _ := current.Messages[0].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-A" {
174			t.Errorf("first tool got %q, want result-A", out)
175		}
176		if out, _ := current.Messages[1].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-B" {
177			t.Errorf("second tool got %q, want result-B", out)
178		}
179	
180		// An orphan result (no pending tool) must not panic or misattribute.
181		attachToolResult(transcriptStep{Type: typeRunCommand, Content: "orphan"}, current, nil)
182		if out, _ := current.Messages[1].Tool.Output["content"].(string); out != "result-B" {
183			t.Errorf("orphan result overwrote a resolved tool: got %q", out)
184		}
185	}
